audit.why: Soul Ignition damages him during the effect and then heals back a portion of that damage at the end. That is healing, and Grievous Wounds reduces it — it being a self-refund rather than lifesteal does not exempt it. Telling a Mordekaiser who wins by extended aura grinding to skip anti-heal is backwards in exactly the fights he is meant to take.
